name: lab-skills
description: Raredon Lab skill suite for scientific work. Bundles the lab's Claude Code skills; skills auto-trigger when a task matches their description. Includes: reference-check (extract, verify via DOI/PMID, and tabulate references, judging citation appropriateness); coding-standards (write R/Python to the lab's Computational Manual standards); and github-standards (repo structure and the RaredonLab fork workflow).
